result.note: Tested the Board of Peace's UN mandate (scope and duration) and executive membership. India's response was still pending, so it is not tested.

questions.prompt: In January 2026, US President Donald Trump invited Prime Minister Narendra Modi to join the 'Board of Peace'. Consider the following statements about the Board:
items: The mandate approved by the UN Security Council in 2025 is limited to Gaza.
The UN Security Council mandate runs until 2030.
Its executive board includes Ajay Banga of the World Bank.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the Security Council mandate runs only until 2027, not 2030. The Board, with Trump at the helm, will oversee a technocratic Palestinian committee governing Gaza, and around 60 countries had been invited.
questions.source: The UN Security Council approved the board’s mandate in 2025, but it’s limited to Gaza and only until 2027.
